articleTitle: Advanced Data Instrumentation for Stunting Analysis in Physical-Cyber Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: In Indonesia, stunting is a serious problem that has drawn a lot of attention from the government. This study offers a novel strategy for preventing stunting by combining the 5-Desk Model used in integrated health posts (Posyandu) with the Cyber-Physical System (CPS) architecture. Chronic malnutrition and childhood diseases can cause stunting, which can result in long-term health issues and cognitive deficits. Despite advancements, it still poses a serious threat to almost every Indonesian province. For the purpose of gathering data in Posyandu, such as registration, growth measurement, recording, counseling, and health services, the 5-Desk Model provides an organized framework. This promotes the well being of the community and gives healthcare professionals the ability to thoroughly monitor important health indicators. This strategy is improved with CPS integration, which results in a four-layered, comprehensive system that includes gamification, business intelligence, information systems, and instrumentation. To maximize efforts to avoid stunting, this architecture facilitates accurate monitoring, real-time data collecting, data analysis, and stakeholder communication. This study imagines a data-driven future for Indonesian stunting prevention, where cooperation, technology, and data are combined to address this pressing problem and safeguard the future prospects and wellbeing of Indonesia’s youth. Implementing this goal and expanding stunting prevention initiatives will be the main goals of future research.

articleTitle: LEGIT Project: Preserving Bandung’s Historic Heritage In a Digital Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Bandung is a city full of historic sites and heritage buildings. Over time, many buildings that used to have high historical value have become tasteless with the flow of time. Therefore, this cultural heritage needs to be preserved. One is through the use of technological media, which is currently being carried out a lot, namely virtual reality or digital twin. Project LEGIT combines SMKN 1 Cimahi and PPTIK ITB, which aims to design a metaverse of Digital-Twin Bandung Raya. Later the 3D characters will meet each other in the virtual world. It will focus more on historic or iconic buildings from the city of Bandung itself. It used various tools from Blender 3D to create models of historical buildings in Bandung City, which will then be converted to Unity 3D. The result will be a metaverse world in which there are similarities with historical buildings in Bandung, such as the digital-twin concept in general, which has avatars that can be connected. This research focuses on the design process and preliminary experiment. The experiments have successfully modelled several historical buildings on Jalan Afrika-Asia as part of the Bandung Raya Digital-Twin Metaverse.

articleTitle: On the Performance of Face Recognition Models for Local Faces Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The number of facial recognition models that have been developed makes many users free to choose the desired model. However, the large number of face recognition models will also raise questions about how effectively the model is used, especially when it is used to verify certain types of faces, for example, Indonesian faces. In this paper, the evaluation results of several face recognition models using Indonesian faces are presented. The models evaluated were facenet based on inception resnet v2 from the deepface library, VGGFace from the deepface library, and facenet Google based on inception resnet v1 from the keras-facenet library. The face detection model used for cropping images is SSD. The method used to carry out the evaluation is to compare the embedding results of two Indonesian sample faces and evaluate the actual value and the predicted result value of the calculated distance. This value is then used to calculate the confusion matrix and the accuracy, precision, recall, and f1score parameters will be calculated [1]. The results show that the keras – facenet model gets the best value with an accuracy of 96.51% with a precision of 100% in the dataset using euclidean threshold 0.75. The calculated evaluation results can be used for considerations in using the face recognition models that have been mentioned, especially for Indonesian faces.

articleTitle: Web-Based Gender Classification ML Application Development for e-KYC
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: e-KYC is used to recognize the user of the system and validate if they are real and has the authority to access the service. The process can be automated using machine learning models. One of the elements of e-KYC is gender classification. The implementation consists of a face detection model and a gender classification model. Two web services, frontend and backend, are used to connect the user to the machine learning models. The product is created to fit in larger e-KYC systems, such as SPBE (Sistem Pemerintahan Berbasis Elektronik/electronic-based government system). The system can capture the users’ image on a website using the devices’ webcams, processes it using two machine learning models, and shows the result in the form of labeled bounding boxes representing the gender and confidence score for every detected face.

articleTitle: Web Login Authentication System Using QR-Code Scanner with Sha-1 Encryption Method
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: When entering a system, the validation method performs sensitive data transactions owned by other people. The interaction between the system and the user for authentication has traditionally only used one username and password authentication stage. It is hazardous for hacking attacks, for example, by brute force or phishing, so the system security is made layered to improve authentication validation. There are many ways to implement layered authentication, one of which is using the QR-code application library as a layered authentication tool to increase the security of transaction log validation to log into an archive management system. Where the mobile application is the key to creating a token replacement for the password used in the desktop application, previously on the desktop, it will generate a unique code converted into an image from the QR code, which the application on the mobile phone will then scan. Validation is relatively safer because it involves three keys, a username, password, and single-use token, generated from a random unique code. Then, every data exchange between the application on the cellphone and the server key is encrypted using Sha-1.

articleTitle: Mobile application and cloud system for Telecommunication natural disasters anticipation
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: In this paper, a mobile and cloud-based platform will be created called telecommunication natural disaster anticipation (TELENADIA). The TELENADIA application is currently only created specifically to display information related to flood natural disasters, so that the features contained in it are made based on the needs of application users regarding information on the causes of flooding, so that the information contained in the application is river water level, rainfall, and wind speed. The information is displayed based on the results of data processing stored in the cloud, the data stored in the cloud is the result of data retrieval from the hardware of the flood detection device, which is sent using an antenna from a place that is difficult to get a signal. The platform will go through a testing and verification phase to determine that the application and cloud used are in line with the paper objectives.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Link Adaptation Problem Formulation in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) have emerged as a promising technology for improving road safety, traffic efficiency, and the overall driving experience. In VANETs, vehicles communicate with each other and with roadside infrastructure to exchange critical safety messages and traffic information. However, the dynamic nature of vehicular environments, including varying vehicular speeds, channel conditions, and network topologies, poses challenges to maintaining reliable and efficient communication links. The current work presents an approach to analyze a specific domain-related problem, formulate it, and develop a machine learning model for Link Adaptation (LA) that could be used in the future to improve communication efficiency in VANETs. As a result, the analysis derived from the developed model demonstrates some consistency in predicting optimal MCS values, accounting for both the relative mobility of the involved nodes and the available signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) level. The proposed Machine learning-based LA model presents a promising avenue to optimize vehicular communication performance, thereby contributing to the realization of safer and smarter transportation systems.

articleTitle: Car Detection over Network using Yolov8 in Forza Horizon 4
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: In the realm of autonomous vehicles, object detection holds a pivotal role in enabling accurate perception and safe navigation within complex environments. This study incorporates these domains by proposing a vehicle detection system employing YOLO v8 within the popular game Forza Horizon 4. YOLO v8’s real-time, accurate object detection prowess aligns seamlessly with the game’s dynamics, enriching the user experience through improved vehicle tracking. The research encompasses YOLO v8 model training on an expansive vehicle dataset, adaptation for Forza Horizon 4, and rigorous evaluation, comparing accuracy, speed, and efficiency against existing methods. The methodology entails dataset preparation, YOLO v8 configuration, object detection, result evaluation, optional fine-tuning, and iterative testing and optimization. By scrutinizing two data transmission protocols, RTMP and HTTPS, the research accentuates RTMP’s superiority in real-time image data transmission for object detection, surpassing HTTPS in processing speed. While RTMP excels in low-latency scenarios, HTTPS augments security through encrypted data transmission. The findings prove RTMP’s speed in image data transmission for real-time object detection, whereas HTTPS’s secure communication advantages.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet of Things Based Aquaculture Technology for Freshwater Lobster Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The development of fisheries technology in Indonesia has not kept pace with the increasing demand for food fish in society. Additionally, Indonesia possesses abundant fishery commodities with high market value. However, Fish farmers face challenges in maintaining the right environment in the cultivation process due to variations in temperature and other parameters across different regions in Indonesia, making it difficult to create suitable environments for the cultured commodities. This challenge is particularly noticeable in the cultivation of freshwater lobsters, despite their high market value both domestically and internationally. In this research, a prototype named Jalasangkuriang was developed, later renamed Artemis in its second production phase. Artemis serves the purpose as a thermoregulation, enabling precise control over the water temperature within the freshwater lobster breeding ponds. This effort was undertaken to assist and facilitate fish farmers in acquiring appropriate technologies aimed in advancing the aquaculture industry in Indonesia towards greater growth and potential. The study consisted of two main activities: first, the creation and implementation of the Artemis prototype, and second, the development of a temperature monitoring system. The monitoring system consists of three DS18B20 temperature sensors, one ESP32, one SD card module, and one TFT display. All the data collected from the monitoring system are sent to the Antares platform using Telkomsel orbit Wi-Fi network. The results obtained from the prototype’s implementation showed an increased productivity of freshwater lobsters. On average, a single super-quality lobster broodstock produced three times more offspring, representing a 300% increase in juvenile lobster production. The temperature monitoring was conducted for three months at three-hour intervals. The results from the temperature monitoring system showed that the temperature changes caused by the prototype were no more than 1$^{\circ} C$, whereas without the prototype, the temperature fluctuations could reach up to 8$^{\circ} C$.

articleTitle: Design of Metal Stamp Machine using Pneumatic Power with PLC Control
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Automation is an unavoidable alternative to obtaining a simple, practical, efficient work system. To support this process, Programmable Logic Control (PLC) can be used. This design aims to make a tool that can be used to stamp metal using a PLC, which is done automatically. The purpose of this metal stamping process is to work to obtain a metal or product that has a stamp (brand). Sensors used in this process are inductive sensors and proximity sensors. The main sensor will detect the presence of metal at a certain distance without touching the object that moves the stamp tool. When the object is detected, inductive and proximity will detect metal objects at a close distance, ranging from 1 mm to several centimeters on the PLC as an input device. Objects will be stamped and selected based on the desired results. From the results of testing the design of the metal stamp control system using programmable logic control (PLC), the design is as expected with movements A +, B +, B-, A-C+, C-, PLC control works well, pneumatic trainer A +, B +, B-, A- C+, C-, the mains voltage on the solenoid goes well, the voltage on the sensor Average is 72.5 volts, voltage measurement at the PLC output of 225 volts.

articleTitle: Web Based Dashboard for Fisherman Radio System in VHF Frequency Band
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Dashboard for fisherman radio system created to make it easier to determine the radio of fishermen who are sailing. This dashboard can be accessed through the website in real time. The fishermen radio dashboard has the website address https://radionelayan.tech.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Transmitter for Quantum Communication Based on Faint Pulse Laser
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The advent of quantum computers marks the beginning of the quantum 2.0 era. Unlike classical computers, quantum computers have faster and more efficient computational abilities, enabling them to break classical encryption such as the RSA (Rivest-Shamir-Adlemar) algorithm in a matter of minutes. To address this threat, a quantum communication system is required, which possesses quantum properties as well. The urgency of developing an independent and autonomous quantum communication system is crucial for a country. In this research, a transmitter for quantum communication based on faint pulse laser is developed. A weakened laser diode is used as the photon source. The laser diode weakening is achieved using a laser driver that generates short-duration pulse signals. By combining AND and XOR logic gates in such a way that when given a square wave input, the output of the logic gate system can produce short-duration pulses. The information in this communication system consists of randomly implemented keys, realized using the myRIO board and serving as a subsystem for random port selection. The designed laser driver produces pulse signals with a width of 128 nanoseconds and an amplitude of 1.5168 V. Additionally, the random port selection subsystem has been successfully designed using the myRIO board. Random numbers from ‘0’ to ‘3’ are generated uniformly. From 100 observation samples, an expected value of 1.445 and a variance of 0.911 are obtained. In the subsequent research, observations of single photon and the generated keys will be conducted.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Air Quality to Identify Public Perspectives in Indonesia Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The worsening air quality in Indonesia, especially in DKI Jakarta, has become a serious concern. In this context, sentiment analysis can provide new information about people’s views and responses to this environmental issue. In this study, we collected data from social media, i.e., the YouTube platform, which reflects people’s views on air quality. We implemented various ML algorithms such as Random Forest, Decision Tree, Naive Bayes, Extra Trees, and Hard Voting Ensemble to analyze the sentiment in the retrieved YouTube comments. We evaluate the performance of each algorithm based on the accuracy in classifying the sentiments. Through sentiment analysis, we identified the most common patterns of views appearing in the analyzed data. The novelty of the research is the application of Machine Learning techniques in analyzing sentiments related to air quality in Indonesia. As a result, all ML algorithms showed accuracy above 90%, except the NB algorithm with 76.14% accuracy. This shows that ML algorithms have good sensitivity to the dataset containing YouTube comments used in this study.

articleTitle: Analysis of Supporting Information Systems for Seminar Activities Using the Ruby on Rails Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Technological developments are increasingly advanced and help many activities. Information Systems Technology is not limited to the use of computers, especially hardware and software, but includes data collection and processing, and system control records. Currently, many marketing communities are holding business education seminars to prepare entrepreneurs to acquire or improve their skills, one of which is the Top-Quality Group Indonesia (TQG-IDN) community. In the process of organizing the seminar, the use of Information System Technology can be a tool to make the seminar more effective. In this research, we will conduct an analysis of the design and development of an information system that aims to assist the seminar process at TQG-IDN which is expected to facilitate the management of user data, event data, and data on seminar venues, seminar ticket stock data, ticket purchase transactions, process attendance by scanning a QR Code, printing seminar certificates, and preparing reports. This system is website-based and designed using the Ruby programming language and the Ruby on Rails framework, while QR code scanning uses the REST API and will be tested using Postman.

articleTitle: An Array 1x2 Multi Band Microstrip Antenna with Triangle Patch using Triangular Slot for Radar C-Band
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: As is known from the characteristics of multiband antennas using microstrip technology in general, they have weaknesses in obtaining adequate parameter responses using standard patch shapes without using slots.. With these problems, a triangular microstrip antenna was created which added a slot and had several working frequencies which were applied to the C-Band radar. In designing a triangular patch using slots, two stages are carried out, where in the first stage the material to be used is selected. After that, the antenna dimensions are calculated. After the size is designed, the next process is to carry out several simulation stages and add slots to patch 1 and patch 2 with a slot width of 2 mm. Then the width of the slot is changed to determine the results of the slot change. The slot uses the same triangular shape as the initial patch. Triangular multiband patch antenna arranged 1X2 with added triangular slots. In the simulation, the S-parameter value was -30.44 dB at a frequency of 4.44 GHz, -19.8 dB at a frequency of 5 GHz, -16.7 dB at a frequency of 5.6 GHz, and -31.3 dB at a frequency 6.2 GHz. With the VSWR value obtained at 1.07 at the 4.4 GHz frequency, 1.2 at the 5 GHz frequency, 1.3 at the 5.6 GHz frequency, 1.06 at the 6.2 GHz frequency. The results of measuring the S-11 parameters on the manufactured antenna showed a return loss value of - 20.78 dB at the 5.4 GHz frequency, -17.27 dB at the 6.7 GHz frequency, and -13.67 at the 5.7 GHz frequency. Meanwhile, the VSWR value obtained during measurement was 1.74 at a frequency of 5.4 GHz, 1.3 at a frequency of 6.7 GHz, 1.5 at a frequency of 5.8 GHz. From the results of simulations and measurements, an antenna has been successfully obtained that works at several frequencies in the C-Band radar with standard parameters that still meet.

articleTitle: Optimizing Art Studio Connectivity: A Haversine and Greedy Algorithm Approach for Navigation in Cirebon Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The proposed geographic information system (GIS) provides a systematic approach to locating and connecting art studios, enabling cultural institutions, artists, and students to collaborate and share resources more efficiently. The implementation of a structured GIS and Haversine Formula and Greedy Algorithm can improve the management and connectivity of art studios in Cirebon, fostering connections and collaboration between art studios, artists, and cultural institutions. This research used a greedy algorithm to find the shortest route from user’s current location to the destination point, i.e., Art Gallery. The Greedy Algorithm is a problem-solving approach that aims to find an optimal solution by iteratively selecting the best local option. The Haversine formula is used to calculate the distance from each connected node using the haversine formula, which converts latitudes and longitudes from degrees to radians and calculates the differences in latitude and longitude. In implementing the nearest art studio search system, the Haversine Formula combined with Greedy Algorithm can be employed as an alternative for search logic since it can directly calculate the distance from the initial point or user’s selected point by utilizing easily identifiable reference points.

articleTitle: Comparison of Dempster Shafer and Certainty Factor for Anxiety Disorder Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: In the current millennial era, many people, especially teenagers, experience mental disorders. Based on research, more than 8% of adolescents have mental and psychological disorders, namely anxiety disorders. This disease has characteristics such as sufferers experiencing anxiety, social disorders and anxiety. This disease cangene be detected by a technological approach that applies an expert-based knowledge system. Methods suitable for this technological approach are certainty factors and dempster shafer which can help detect uncertainty in diagnosing mental illness. In this study, the Certainty Factor and Dempster Shafer methods were used to detect anxiety disorders and compared with the results from experts. This research gives the results of validation sampling accuracy with experts of 93.33 % for the certainty factor method and the dempster shafer method has an accuracy of 80%. So, the certainty factor method is more recommended for detecting anxiety disorders.

articleTitle: Designing a Smart Garden for Automated Plant Watering using Flutter and Internet of Things in the Context of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Plant maintenance in educational institutions often needs consistent watering practices, leading to plant withering and decline. This research endeavors to develop an intelligent gardening system employing Flutter and the Internet of Things (IoT) to automate plant watering based on soil moisture levels. The research focuses on loose soil conditions, categorized through laboratory testing at a high school, with classifications ranging from 0.3V-1.27V for water-rich soil, 1.28V-1.79V for wet soil, 1.80V-2.60V for dry ground, and 2.61V-2.90V for parched earth. This study implements IoT principles into an Android application to enable automated plant watering when soil moisture levels indicate dryness

articleTitle: Analysis of Decision Tree and Random Forest Algorithms for Nutrient Deficiency Classification in Citrus Leaves through Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The research presents a hybrid approach to identify and categorise nutritional deficiency syndrome in citrus leaves using image processing and machine learning. The method includes processing images, segmenting images and extracting color-texture information. The Decision Tree and the Random Forest algorithms use various statistical measures for classification, including mean, skewness, variance, entropy, maximum probability, angular second moment, contrast, correlation, dissimilarity, energy, and homogeneity. The test results show a range of performance levels, with an accuracy of 80.28% being attained by utilising an 80:20 data ratio in the Decision Tree approach. The Random Forest method’s highest accuracy, 91.25%, was reached using an 80:20 ratio. In conclusion, the accuracy of the Random Forest approach regularly beats that of the Decision Tree method.

articleTitle: 2.3 GHz Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna with Elegtromagnetic Band Gap Technique for Body Area Use
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Wearable antennas that are small, lightweight, easy to make and others are needed. The Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) of the wearable antenna must be smaller than 1.6. This research designs a rectangular patch wearable antenna with a mushroom-shaped Electromagnetic Band Gap (EBG) operating at a frequency of 2.35 GHz. The addition of EBG to the microstrip antenna aims to increase the gain value of the wearable antenna. In addition, the addition of EBG is also expected to reduce the SAR value. The addition of EBG is proven to increase the gain by 17.5% compared to the antenna without EBG. The SAR value after the addition of EBG is 0.0852 W/Kg, 88.96% smaller than the antenna without EBG.

articleTitle: Enhancing Seedbeds Climate Control System with Internet of Things-Based Remote Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Efficient climate control management in seedbeds plays a crucial role in ensuring optimal conditions for plant growth and development. In this research, we propose enhancing the seedbeds’ climate control system by integrating Internet of Things (IoT)-based remote automation. The objective of this study is to leverage IoT technologies to remotely monitor and control the climate parameters of seedbeds. The DHT11 sensor is used to measure humidity and room temperature, the TEMT 600 sensor is used to measure light intensity, the YL-100 sensor is used as a soil moisture sensor, and the Arduino Uno is used as the overall system controller. As actuators, a real-time clock (RTC) is utilized to schedule system operations. By integrating these sensors and utilizing the Arduino Uno as the controller, real-time data on temperature, humidity, light intensity, and soil moisture can be collected and analyzed. This data enables automated adjustments to maintain the ideal climate conditions for seedbeds. The integration of IoT-based remote automation offers several advantages. Firstly, it enables remote monitoring and control, allowing farmers or growers to manage multiple seedbeds simultaneously from a centralized location. Secondly, it facilitates data-driven decision-making by providing insights into the climate conditions and allowing for timely adjustments. Thirdly, it improves efficiency and productivity by automating routine tasks and reducing the need for manual intervention. This research aims to develop a robust and reliable system that enhances the seedbeds’ climate control through IoT-based remote automation. Results showed that the quality of cabbage seeds from this study was improved by 29.6%. The proposed system has the potential to optimize plant growth, minimize resource wastage, and improve overall agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Development of Passive Liveness Detection System Based on Deep Learning LivenessNet to Overcome Face Spoofing
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This paper is focused on developing a real-time and robust passive liveness detection system to overcome a consequential challenge on existing face recognition systems, face spoofing. Our passive liveness detection system is a web-based system that is able to classify between real and 2D spoofing facial images. Our system consists of face detection and liveness detection process. For face detection, we conduct a comparative evaluation of pre-trained models to obtain the best-performing model. For liveness detection, we use LivenessNet, a lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture. Using LivenessNet, we conduct an experimental evaluation of its hyperparameters value to obtain the most accurate model. The final result of our system can achieve 97.17% validation accuracy, 0% False Positive Rate, 5.68% False Negative Rate, and an inference time of 0.25 ms per frame.

articleTitle: Similarity Measures Implementation on Face Authentication using Indonesian Citizen ID Card
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The aim of this study is to demonstrate to computer science students the application of basic algebra concepts, particularly distance, in face authentication. Our simulation presents the results obtained from face authentication using five face images from 39 respondents and an Indonesian citizen ID card (KTP). We utilized MTCNN and RetinaFace for face detection and FaceNet512 for feature extraction. The KTP and images were then compared using Cosine, Euclidean, and Euclidean-L2 distances. The outcomes indicate that RetinaFace achieved a 100% success rate in image detection during this simulation, whereas MTCNN only reached 99.15%. The Cosine Distance method obtained the best Specificity and Accuracy results for both face detection techniques. In terms of Recall score, the RetinaFace-Euclidean Distance method shows a better performance than the other available scenarios.

articleTitle: The Effect of Ethereum’s Proof of Stake Update on Ethereum Price Using the Long Short-Term Memory Method
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Cryptocurrency is a digital or virtual currency secured by cryptography. Using cryptography, this digital currency is nearly impossible to counterfeit. All transaction records are stored on the blockchain. Ethereum is one of the cryptocurrencies, along with Bitcoin, etc. Ethereum was first created in 2013 by Vitalik Buterin, a professional programmer, with the goal of building decentralized applications. Ethereum was launched in 2015 with its own cryptocurrency called ether. Proof of Stake (PoS) is the underlying mechanism that activates validators after receiving sufficient stake. For Ethereum, users need to stake 32 ETH to become validators. The objectives of this research are to understand the general overview of ETH prices in the past two years, assess the effectiveness of transitioning from Proof of Work (PoW) to PoS, and explore the application of long-short-term memory (LSTM) in price prediction. The results of this research indicate that the LSTM model is well-suited for predicting prices with a sufficiently large and complex dataset. The evaluation parameters, including the root mean square error (RMSE) with a value of 130.109, the mean squared error (MSE) with a value of 16928.408, and the mean absolute error (MAE) with a value of 92.9926, show that the performance of the LSTM model is good.

articleTitle: Increasing The Efficiency of Electricity Use of PLTP Motor Control Center (MCC) Using Automatic Electronic System at PT PGE Karaha
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The government’s efforts to maintain national energy stability through programs to increase supply and save energy must be supported by all levels of society, including the upstream side. This study analyzes the potential percentage of electrical energy savings on the upstream side, namely the generation sector. In this study, we will discuss the potential for saving electrical energy own use at PLTP Karaha 1 Pertamina Geothermal Energy located in Tasikmalaya district, West Java. In supporting the operation of PLTP Karaha unit 1, patrol check activities are needed which function to monitor the condition of generating equipment to ensure that the supporting equipment of the generator is in optimal condition. But in fact, when the patrol check activity has been completed, the room lights or indoor lighting are left on for 24 hours continuously due to the engineering design of the lights during the EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) process. So, a control system is designed to operate indoor lighting automatically using Passive Infra-Red (PIR) sensors and Arduino ATMega 2560 module. Programming on Arduino is done using the Arduino IDE application. In the Arduino IDE application, it shows the library initialization program (sensor) and the initialization of the pins used on the Arduino. The program made on the Arduino IDE application is a program to control the On-Off lights, the LCD display includes the number of people entering the MCC room, the On-Lamp time and the total energy kWh. By using this method, it is hoped that it can be a solution for saving the use of electrical energy for indoor lighting.

articleTitle: Best Platform for Remote Site Fuel level Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: National power grid challenges has forced telecommunication companies to rely more on standby generators as a secondary power source for their remote sites. However, this came with challenges such as increased fuel budget, fuel theft, Fuel mismanagement and fraud during refueling of the generator tanks. Rapid fuel cost increases have resulted to a high number of fuel theft and fraud incidents in refueling process. This paper explores different methods of fuel monitoring methods, study their merits and their tradeoffs analytically, then choose a suitable one to implement a remote fuel level monitoring and management system using Internet of things (IoT). The current work investigates a variety of remote site monitoring methods available in the field. Analysis is performed and their comparison developed against cost, power consumption, stability, reliability, efficiency, user interface, and time (processing and speed) to pinpoint the advantages, and disadvantages of various methods encountered in literature in order to advise on a more suitable choice for our application. The finding results revealed that Arduino board was the best choice for the remote fuel monitoring application.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of String Matching Methods for Consumer Data Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Searching for data or information has become a necessity in today’s digital era. One type of data search that is often used is string matching or patterns in a text. The speed of an application in the data search process, especially applications that have many users and large data on a server is a challenge, especially for digital business companies. Internet connection, powerful servers, effective and efficient data search algorithms are some of the determining factors. In general, string matching uses the SQL Query Like method. In this research, a comparison of several algorithm methods that can be used in string search, including Boyer-Moore, Naive String Matching, Knuth-Morris-Pratt and Rabin-Karp Algorithm to find the best algorithm in the data search process. From the tests that have been carried out, the results of the Boyer More algorithms are faster than other algorithms or 45.8% faster based on performance testing with 250,000 data. In the memory usage testing process, the average memory used by SQL is more than other algorithms.

articleTitle: ML-Agents in Kart Racing Game using Microgame
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach to integrating ML-Agents into a microgame-based kart racing environment, showcasing the potential for enhancing gameplay experiences through AI-driven opponents. Kart Unity Game is a racing game that uses small motorized vehicles but still uses the concept of racing in the real world. One of the racing game development platforms is Unity. Unity has developed a platform, Unity Karting Microgame, which users can modify. Unity Karting Microgame applies self-driving to ML-Agents trained and designed to drive their karts with suitable sensors and actuators. The method used to develop the game is to modify the racetrack and modify ML-Agents to make the game more exciting and fun. As a result of this study, successful implementation of ML-Agents in a microgame-based kart racing environment. The study highlights the potential of using Unity ML-Agents to create AI-driven opponents that enrich gameplay experiences. Games can run well and seem varied. ML-Agents can also control their karts on their lanes. Thus, kart racing games can be implemented.

articleTitle: Automatic Drying Roof with Short Messages (SMS) using a Microcontroller Module
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The drying process must be monitored when weather conditions are uncertain. A sudden downpour can cause the clothesline to get wet again. It wastes time and energy because the drying process must be repeated from the beginning. This project is about the design and realization of an automatic roof device that protects the clothesline from rainwater and supports the drying process so that the laundry can dry on time. Raindrop sensors and LDR sensors are used to capture weather conditions during the drying process. The results of the sensor measurements would cause the motor gearbox to open or close the roof, which is connected to the L298N Motor Driver Module. The fan turns on when the roof is closed, and DHT 21 measures the room temperature and humidity. When the sensor readings detect the drying of items, the GSM module sends an SMS notification to the owner of the clothesline. The readings from the inputs of the sensors are processed by the Arduino Uno microcontroller module and displayed on the LCD. The result of this project system is that the device can work automatically to protect the clothesline from raindrops with a success rate of 95% and a success rate of 77.77% in the sensory measurement according to the condition of the clothesline’s humidity.

articleTitle: Volumetric Analysis and Mass Flow Monitoring System For Boiler Machine Based On SCADA System
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The design of a steam flow and capacity monitoring system for a SCADA-based boiler machine at PT Biofarma has been carried out. This monitoring or monitoring system aims to determine the capacity of hot steam used in units (Kg/h), the flow rate of hot steam (M3/h) and the total use of steam capacity released by the steam boiler output. This monitoring system uses an existing flow sensor measuring instrument with a differential pressure type and a new flow sensor with an ultrasonic type. This sensor measuring instrument is integrated with a programmable logic controller (PLC) device to process input data from the sensor to display flow data, capacity and total use of hot steam released by the boiler. Data visualization that has been processed by the PLC will be displayed on a PC via a web page and can be accessed via smartphone. Retrieval of monitoring system data on boiler steam output will be recorded in real time via the human machine interface (HMI) page and remotely using the SCADA system

articleTitle: Integrated System of Multi-Location Tank Volume Monitoring Based on NRF24L01Plus
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The increase in the number of private vehicles in the community increases every year, with the increase in the number of private vehicles uses causing the need for fuel to continue to increase so that often the supply of fuel at public filling stations (SPBU) cannot serve the needs of the community because the new fuel supply is not proportional to the amount of fuel purchased and causes the fuel stock at the SPBU to run out before the new fuel supply comes. Usually, the measurement of fuel stocks is done manually using the measurement method using a dipstick, because using the manual method the stock of fuel in the tank cannot be monitored in real-time and causes inaccuracies in monitoring fuel stocks. Then a system was designed that has been integrated in monitoring tank volume stock using the HY-SRF05 ultrasonic sensor mounted on a different tank and using the NRF24L01+ PA LNA transceiver communication module. The data read by the sensor ultrasonic HY-SRF05 height sensor for detect volume in the tank which is placed in a different tank will be transmitted by the NRF24L01+ PA LNA module and will be captured by the same receiver, the data will be processed so that it will be displayed on the LCD and the Google Sheet IOT platform and the reading data will be into an excel document so that the results of the reading can be a reference in managing the stock of fuel. By using this method, the tank volume can be monitored in real time.

articleTitle: Neural Networks Architecture and Hyperparameter Exploration for Handover Simulation in 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This paper presents a machine learning based approach for optimizing handover in 5G networks. By using the capabilities of neural networks, the proposed method enables proactive decision-making for target cell selection in handover process. Through analysis of key neural networks parameters, such as hidden nodes and epoch number, the neural network model predicts the target cell for handover. The simulations demonstrated the download success rate for each handover (HO). The results validate the advantages of using neural networks for handover optimization in 5G networks, providing seamless connectivity and improved user experience.

articleTitle: Target Point Detection to Assist Referee Decision-Making In Kempo Martial Arts Matches
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Kempo sports martial arts is a discipline, a sport that combines fighting techniques from various traditional martial arts. In kempo matches, especially in the free combat branch, one of the important factors in making decisions is the ability to detect the correct target points and the right time. This ability can only be obtained by referees who have referee experience and skills. However, in matches, circumstances often occur that can affect the referee’s decisions which can lead to subjective and inconsistent decisions. consistent. This research can make a positive contribution in increasing objectivity and consistency in decision making in kempo competitions. In addition, the developed simulation system can also be used as a training tool for competition participants to improve their skills in detecting target points effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: Multiplatform-Based Infaq And Waqf Application Using Dijkstra Algorithm In Bandung City
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This research project develops a multiplatform mobile application for simplifying charitable donations and fund management in the context of Infaq and Waqf activities in Bandung City. Utilizing the Dijkstra algorithm, the application optimizes fund allocation by considering factors like geographic proximity and project impact. It enhances accessibility across diverse devices and operating systems, expanding participation in charitable endeavors. The project covers design, development, and testing phases, ensuring functionality and security. Ultimately, it contributes to philanthropy by streamlining donations and improving the impact of charitable initiatives in the region.

articleTitle: LoRa LLCC68 Based Data Transmission System For Drinking Water Quality Monitoring Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Control and inspection of water quality are often measured manually making it ineffective and inefficient for refill gallon entrepreneurs who have more than 1 branch. So, this research designed a tool that can remotely monitor water quality in real time. The tool is designed to use a 4502C pH sensor to measure acidity and a SEN0189 turbidity sensor to measure turbidity levels and a remote communication module with LoRa LLCC68. This system was successfully realized with 2 transmitters and 1 receiver. The results of measuring the pH value on transmitters A and B are good enough where the results obtained in measuring white water are in the range of 6.5 to 8.5 and the results for measuring turbidity values on transmitters A and B are below 25 NTU.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation Of 433 MHz Radio Communications System as a Secondary Network for BMKG Sensor Data Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: the provision of meteorological, climatological, air quality and geophysical data is crucial in an archipelago and mountainous country like Indonesia. The availability of this data is closely related to the provision of internet access in areas that store BMKG sensors. But sometimes geographical constraints such as the natural contours of the Indonesian archipelago with the ocean, mountains and hills can hamper collection this information. Therefore, we need a data collection system that can handle the problem without the influence of geographical constraints. A radio communication system is proposed to meet the availability of information on climate data and other sensor data from the Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysics Agency (BMKG), especially for areas not covered by cellular network services so that the availability of sensor data can increase. This communication system use the 433 MHz frequency spectrum which is become a Low Power Wide Area (LPWA) field.

articleTitle: Frequency Monitoring Interface Design and System using HackRF
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Kominfo as a regulator in communication technology, especially in the distribution of frequency usage, always monitors the frequency circulating in the field. However, Indonesia’s vast territory makes some areas outside urban areas difficult to reach. Therefore, a portable frequency monitoring system will be created. This prototype was created to maximize the monitoring system in the form of storage, processing, and visualization. Therefore, a dashboard interface that is integrated with Hack RF will be created with historical features and good visualization. This feature is needed with the aim that there are no errors or violations in the use of frequencies circulating in open spaces. The frequency monitoring system created will be accessible from any device in the same network as the website GUI system and integrated with SDR HackRF. In the GUI we will be able to listen to the sound according to the frequency we set, and the most important thing is to know the three main aspects of the spectrum, namely frequency, bandwidth, and gain. These three aspects will then be inputted from the dashboard into the database which will then be compared with the legal frequency data prototype. The results of the comparison will generate an alert system using the telegram bot.

articleTitle: The Information Security Readiness in Indonesian Government Institution: A systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Information Security Governance is recognized as one of the most important aspects in achieving the success of E-Government in Indonesia. these factors can assist institutions in implementing information security services to be effective and safe. This study discusses the theory of information security readiness from the perspective of e-government in Indonesia as well as theories that have been found and discussed by previous researchers. This research uses literature study and meta-analysis as a research methodology. The literature review is carried out by reviewing articles relevant to the topic “Information Security readiness”. This study finds that Culture (C) and Institutional Characteristics (IC) are significant factors that affect the readiness of information security on E-Government in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Design of pH Control in a Wastewater Treatment System Using an ESP8266 Microcontroller Based on IoT Thingspeak
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Industrial activities in producing goods or services make various positive impacts in Indonesian economic activities. However, every production activity conducted by particular industries certainly also brings negative impacts, namely waste as a by-product of these industrial activities. The effects of the waste produced can certainly disrupt environmental balance. One of the wastes produced by an industry can be liquid waste. Liquid waste is the remainder of a business and/or activity in liquid form. Every industry must process their liquid waste or pollutants properly in order to prevent the industry from violating the quality standard limits set by the government. One of the liquid waste parameters that must be maintained to prevent pollution does not occur is pH. Therefore, wastewater control is needed to keep the pH value. This study designs a pH monitoring and control system in a wastewater neutralizer tub at a wastewater treatment plant (WWTP). This study uses a system that provides data on the pH value of wastewater in wastewater neutralizer tanks at wastewater treatment plants (WWTP) where the pH sensor 4502C and NodeMcu ESP8266 function as microcontrollers. The data are then sent to the ThingSpeak IoT platform, where the measurement results are sent to an application called Kodular, which is accessible on an Android smartphone. The results show that based on testing the pH 4502C sensor, this study has obtained good readings with an error rate of 0.34% - 0.37% and a good error rate of 6%. In addition, the monitoring process is running well. The indicator can be seen from the value displayed on ThingSpeak and the Android application according to the results displayed via the Arduino IDE serial monitor. In terms of monitoring data transmission on the ThingSpeak platform, there are still many delays because ThingSpeak can only send data every 15 seconds. 0.1s in the opposite direction until it returns to its original location.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Mininet-based Testbed for Software Defined Network with P4 Programmable Data Plane
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Network technology has continued to evolve because of the expanding use of the internet in numerous fields. One approach for addressing the difficulties of maintaining larger networks is Software-Defined Networking (SDN), which separates the control plane and data plane. Typically, SDN utilizes OpenFlow as an API for communication between the control plane and data plane. However, OpenFlow has limitations, such as the restricted set of protocols that can be defined in the header as it also does not control the switch behavior of processing the packets. SDN with programmable data plane using P4 offers flexibility in defining protocols or how packets are processed in the data plane, addressing these limitations. This Mininet-based testbed development for P4 is addressed to analyze performance through parameters such as delay, jitter, throughput, packet loss, and CPU usage. Based on the experiment, the amount of processing packets must go through has an impact on the delay seen in the testing. The jitter resulted in relatively small values which indicated stable delays. The throughput achieved in all scenarios was still far below the allocated bandwidth. This can be attributed to the allocation of bandwidth exceeding the server’s specification limits where Mininet is running, leading to high CPU usage and suboptimal packet delivery. Consequently, a significant packet loss rate is observed as well.

articleTitle: Development of OTFS Receiver System Using SDR
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Wireless communication technology is expected to provide various services, including those for mobile terminals. Furthermore, with the increasing demand for communication bandwidth and the limited availability of frequency spectrum, there is a growing trend towards utilizing higher frequency bands like millimeter waves. However, under these circumstances, conventional systems such as Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) are susceptible to the challenges posed by high Doppler spread. Over the past few years, several technologies have emerged to tackle these challenges, and one of them is the Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) modulation system. Research on this system has garnered significant attention. In this paper, a prototype receiver is developed as part of an OTFS modulation system transceiver, enabling real time signal transmission. This prototype was created using MATLAB software in conjunction with the Software Defined Radio (SDR) Adalm Pluto device. Simple algorithms for frame synchronization, channel estimation, and equalization were implemented to ensure the receiver can effectively receive and recover data. To demonstrate data transmission, a straightforward encoding/decoding approach for text and image data was utilized. The system tested by conducting real time data transmission in static outdoor wireless channel. The system is using only one SDR with transmitter and receiver antenna is separated by 4.5m. The results demonstrated for a transmission of a picture at frequency carrier of 3.5 GHz with 0 dB gain TX and 50 dB gain RX, the Bit Error Rate (BER) has reached 0.005.

articleTitle: Analysis of Attack Scenarios Relating to Changes in Voter Votes on E-Voting Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: One of the causes of the lack of public trust in this e-voting system is the untrustworthy technology used. There are several examples of attacks on the e-voting system that have occurred that have made people doubt the technology used in this e-voting. One of the closest issues to attacks on e-voting is Russia’s interference in the United States presidential election activities. The NSA stated that hackers from Russia had tried to inject malware into the DRE machine used. On the other hand, another source states that the attacks carried out are just the spread of hoaxes for campaigns. However, this issue has an impact on people’s confidence in the e-voting system. Based on the example of the attack, it can be concluded that in an e-voting design, it cannot be assumed that the system is safe against attacks. Therefore, this e-voting system’s vulnerability needs to be analyzed to design risk mitigations against possible attacks. In this study, an attack analysis was carried out to identify possible attacks on the e-voting system for vote changes from voters.

articleTitle: Switch Diversity Technology in Mitigating Attenuation of Fiber Optic Signal Receiver Ku-Band VSAT Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The need for a communication system using VSAT technology on the Ku-Band band is now starting to develop in Indonesia, both the need for pay TV or internet provision, The problem in using VSAT Ku-band technology is propagation that occurs due to weather disturbances, especially rain. As a result of these weather conditions, it produces a high enough attenuation which can result in disruption, disturbance at a certain level can have an impact on service down. The switch diversity program is used to move channels from transmission networks that are affected by interference to other transmission channels. The fiber optic diversity channel under study has two channels. In this study, researchers conducted an analysis by making a comparison between two fiber optic cores using a diversity switch to determine the quality of the signal when the transmission path is exposed to rain. The results of the research on fiber optic links from the two transmission lines of one transmission obtain a signal quality that is less strong below the fair reference limit value where the value is −10.73 dB. Meanwhile, one transmission path has a fairly low attenuation value and signal reception is better close to the reference value. Signal-to-noise ratio Normal Downstream SNR 155 dB, Abnormal SNR < 80 dB.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Reduction Using Proximity Coupled Dolph Tschebyscheff Array Antenna for Wi-Fi 6E
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This paper examines the configuration of an array antenna featuring a rectangular patch and a power distribution technique known as Dolph Tschebyscheff. The application of Dolph Tschebyscheff distribution aims to suppress unwanted sidelobes that arise from modifying the antenna with multiple elements. The array antenna consists of three rectangular elements and operates at a frequency of 6.175 GHz. Each patch element is supplied using a proximity coupling technique to achieve a broad bandwidth. The stacked antenna is constructed using two layers of FR-4 dielectric substrate, each measuring 68.7 mm $\times 50.8$ mm with a thickness of 0.8 mm. The simulation results demonstrate a bandwidth of 295 MHz, a sidelobe level of -14.8 dB, and a gain exceeding 8 dBi at approximately 6.175 GHz. With its wide bandwidth, desirable gain, and low sidelobe characteristics, the designed stacked antenna is suitable for applications in Wi-Fi 6E.

articleTitle: The Development of a Low-Cost Two-Axis CNC Laser Engraver with a Bluetooth Connection
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This paper presents a compact multi-purpose computer numerical control (CNC) laser engraver design. The implementation of the CNC system becomes complex to cope with customers’ needs and requires a large amount of cost in the application of industries. This paper’s goal is to develop a CNC 2D Laser Engraver in a compact system with a Bluetooth connection. The board is equipped with 4 pinouts of the A4988 motor driver, Arduino with a CNC Shield controller, and a motor stepper driver. The CNC machine receives an order from Android with Bluetooth HC-05, and GRBL orders the laser to be on and the stepper motor will move respectively with coordinates determined by GRBL. The specialty of this system is that the users can easily change whether they want to perform operations with smartphones, microSD cards, or computers and produce 2D drawings and objects in different media types. The result from this paper shows that the engraving process of the Cilacap State of Polytechnic logo requires a laser intensity of 400 to 750 mW while engraving acrylic media requires a laser intensity of 400 - 600 mW depending on the speed of the stepper motor that we set at the beginning process.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of An Employee Data Processing System for SMEs Using Marvel Apps and Javascript
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This research purpose is to develop a web-based employee data management system specifically for SMEs. With the problems that occur in the employee management data in SMEs that still use manual methods such as writing on paper and using manual spreadsheets, this approach is often inefficient, prone to errors, difficult to control, and does not provide easy access to needed information; it is essential to build a computerized system. The employee data processing information system is built to facilitate the proper management of employee data and is accurately accompanied by management or control over web-based computerized systems for SMEs. This will support the smooth running of business processes in SMEs, such as storing employee personal data, inputting attendance, and calculating salaries. This research aims to build an employee data processing information system using the prototyping method with Marvel Apps as a prototyping tool and JavaScript as the primary programming language. The results of this research are expected to provide significant benefits for SMEs in managing personnel data, increasing efficiency, reducing administrative errors, expediting payroll processes, and providing easy access and exchange of information by using the system application.

articleTitle: Individual Health Profiling Using Multimodal Sensors on Smart Health Care
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Health Service, also referred to as Health Care System, plays a pivotal role in maintaining and enhancing health by preventing illnesses and injuries. In this context, electronic health records are essential for both inpatients and outpatients, serving as a crucial tool for healthcare providers and policymakers. However, the potential of these records extends beyond individual care to support broader health policy and research initiatives. Personal Smart Health Care, an individual-based digital health technology, bridges the gap between personal health management and medical records, enabling comprehensive healthcare improvements. Smart healthcare, driven by technologies like IoT, mobile applications, cloud computing, big data, 5G, artificial intelligence, and biotechnology, offers a holistic approach to healthcare, emphasizing diagnosis, treatment, disease prevention, risk monitoring, and virtual assistance. An intelligent framework for smart healthcare includes four layers: the instrumentation layer, information system layer, business intelligence layer, and gamification layer, each contributing to enhanced patient outcomes, streamlined processes, and improved patient care. The gamification layer incentivizes healthy behaviors and fosters patient engagement, especially in healthcare scenarios. This comprehensive framework underscores the transformative potential of smart healthcare, where technology-driven solutions can revolutionize the healthcare landscape, improving patient care, health management, and the overall well-being of individuals and populations.

articleTitle: Design of HDTV Receiver Antenna Treefor 400MHZ-800MHZ UHF Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: There is a requirement for an antenna’s usefulness and effectiveness along with the advancement of technology. In addition to having a high bandwidth, it also has a straightforward form. For instance, TV antenna that may be installed indoors and come in a variety of shapes and sizes are now frequently available. Currently, we are creating a microstrip antenna, which is a small, straightforward antenna with a thin and compact design. The issue might have a solution in microstrip. This microstrip antenna is constructed from a copper plate with a substrate dielectric in the center. In this investigation, a copper conductor with a dielectric constant of 3.9 and a thickness of 0.1 mm was employed as the substratum for a microstrip antenna made of the EPOXY FR 4material. With the use of CST software, theoretical calculations are used to create the design of the antenna before it is constructed and measured to produce the desired results. The outcomes of the simulation are shown on decreased values of return loss and gain in the measurement of antenna realization. At frequencies 528 MHz, 495 MHz, and 723 MHz, return loss values of −28.81 dB produced return loss values of 10,01 dB. The VSWR is 1.9 at a 496 MHz frequency. The antenna’s bandwidth was 233.06 MHZ, and the simulation gain was 3.38 dB.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Raspberry Pi-based Testbed Development for P4 Programmable Data Plane
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The development of information technology in various fields makes the network bigger and more complex. The software-defined network appears as a solution that changes the paradigm of the network management problem by separating the data plane and controller centrally on the control plane. Currently, SDN comes with a programmable data plane with the P4 language which is more flexible than OpenFlow as a link between the data plane and the control plane. The Raspberry Pi-based testbed for P4 programmable data plane is a platform for testing the performance of the data plane and P4 programs before being implemented in production. This project analyzes the performance of the Raspberry Pi-based testbed by measuring several network parameters such as delay, throughput, jitter, and packet loss using several test scenarios. Based on the experiment results, the amount of packet processing in each scenario affects the delay parameter. Small jitter parameters indicate a stable delay during the experiment. CPU performance has huge impact to the testbed performance and can be seen in the throughput and packet loss test results using different values of bandwidth, buffer length, and room temperature.

articleTitle: Developing IoT Wireless Sensor Network For Respiration Storage Chamber
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The role of fresh fruit and vegetables respiration rate is a main postharvest handling. This research designed an internet of things (IoT) respirometer to measure respiration activities of fruit and vegetables. The respirometer consisted oxygen (O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), carbondioxide (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) and humidity sensors, microcontroller, esp32, nextion display and respiration chamber. Sensors node generate data and processed by NodeMCU esp32 and the respiration data transferred by internet network and cloud database. The O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sensor interfenece was less 0.1%, CO2 sensor accuracy ±70 ppm of reading, SHT-30 accuracy ±2% and temperature ±0.3°C. The respirometer based IoT system provides a real-time measurement and good fit data measurement that was tested for oyster mushroom storage.

articleTitle: SIW-Based Waveguide Antenna With Structured Slots
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Wifi signal optimization is done through antenna modification. This research describes the design and characterization of a waveguide antenna with slots arranged based on SIW. The antenna is designed to work at a frequency of2.4 GHz in accordance with the Wi-Fi frequency. The antenna design uses a 1.6 mm thick FR-4 Epoxy dielectric substrate material with a relative permittivity of 4.25. The antenna has dimensions of 203.7 mm $\times$ 37.5 mm with 4 identical rectangular slots arranged crosswise with a distance between the center points of adjacent slots of 37.3 mm. The rectangular slots have dimensions of 24 mm $\times$ 6 mm. This antenna consists of 3 patch parts put together, namely a rectangular patch, a connector patch, and a trapezium patch. The connector patch is rectangular with dimensions of 2.4 mm $\times$ 16 mm and the trapezium patch has a base side width of 37 mm and a height of 36 mm. Via is mounted on the periphery of a rectangular antenna with a diameter of 1 mm. The realization results show that the antenna still functions at a frequency of 2.4 GHz with a reflection coefficient of -11.72 dB and a bandwidth of1.67%.

articleTitle: Automatic System Monitoring Analysis For Raw Water Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Entering the era of digital 4.0 means that everything can take place in the blink of an eye and is in the hands of all of us. Not only is communication technology developing rapidly, but economic growth is also having a positive impact. The presence of industry 4.0 is now starting to be felt in various lines of life. Starting from agriculture, animal husbandry, health, education, to trade. Like it or not, we must be able to adapt to the current situation in the modern world, in order to survive. And our presence cannot be shifted by the existence of increasingly sophisticated technology, which can now replace human tasks more effectively and efficiently. Industry 4.0 is a modern era that is now starting to occur and aims to ease human tasks, but as modern humans we must also be willing to learn and adapt so as not to be left behind with the progress of the times. In general, automation is a method or process of using a machine, control system, or information technology to further optimize the production process, or delivery system for goods and services. This automation process is generally carried out if it is felt that the previous process took quite a long time when using human labor both based on quantity and quality factors. When talking about the role of automation in world industries, automation concept is an improvement on the concept mechanization. During the mechanization era, application still required the assistance of human muscle power so that the machine was able to do the job well. So this is where the role of automation begins, namely to further alleviate the role of human workers

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Fishermen Radio for Data Communication via Audio Signal on Very High Frequency (VHF) Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: This fisherman’s radio offers a radio communication tool for fishermen’s safety at an affordable price and adapts to maritime frequencies on the very high frequency (VHF) spectrum, especially in Indonesia. At the transmitter, the input is in the form of a location point from the GPS in the form of longitude and latitude. This location point will be converted into a voice signal based on Morse code with Arduino Nano. An audio signal with a frequency of 156.5 MHz is transmitted using the DRA818V transceiver module. The receiver will receive this audio signal and then retranslate it into the initial GPS location point again using the Goertzel algorithm. The decoded results then become data to be integrated with the dashboard database on the Radio Nelayan website.

articleTitle: Distance Detection on an Autonomous Vehicle Using the Triangle Similarity Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Currently, autonomous vehicle advancement is very rapid, especially for developing algorithms or methods to support autonomous systems. Autonomous vehicles have become a hot topic in intelligent transportation and will improve safety on the road. This research aims to propose an autonomous vehicle safety system by detecting the distance between vehicles as initial research for the concept of autonomous vehicles regarding safe driving. For the car detection process, the Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) method is used to obtain feature extraction from car objects. In the classification process, Support Vector Machine (SVM) linear classification is used to classify the car object. The main contribution of this research is to propose vehicle distance detection in autonomous vehicles using a triangle similarity approach. The triangle similarity is used to detect and calculate the distance (focal length) between the camera and the detected object. The decision boundary is obtained regarding the safe distance to the vehicle by marking the box in red for unsafe distances and green for safe distances. The result showed that accuracy reaches 75%, the MSE for bounding box has a value of 0.2, and the MSE for distance status has a value of 0.125.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Beam Steering Using 8×8 Butler Matrix on X-Band Array Antenna for AESA Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The beam steering system which consists of rectangular array antenna and $8 \times 8$ Butler Matrix are presented. This system can work properly at 9.4 GHz for AESA radar of the fighter aircraft usage. The antenna has eight linear arrays with 40 single patches and was successfully implemented since the average value of return loss in each linear array is 32.18 dB. The Butler Matrix also can do beam steering. The main lobe position, when the input port (from first until eighth port) of Butler Matrix is supplied, leads to 50°, 250°, 80°, 300°, 40°, 310°, 60°, and 310°. Both antenna and Butler Matrix are implemented using FR-4 epoxy as the substrate. While in simulating the Butler Matrix, it uses two different substrates there are FR-4 epoxy and Duroid (RT 5880) to compare the performance.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband Wilkinson Power Divider Using Stepped Impedance For Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: The Wilkinson power divider plays a critical role in microwave engineering and circuit design, comprising passive components and offering reversibility, enabling it to serve as a power combiner when needed. The method proposed for designing this power divider is based on an analysis of even/odd mode circuits and strip transmission lines. The design process relies on established equations, and initial designs were fine-tuned for achieving ultra-wideband frequencies. As a result, the dimensions of the power divider were optimized to 90 mm by 71 mm. The frequency range of this Wilkinson power divider satisfies the demands of ultra-wideband applications, spanning from 3 GHz to 10.6 GHz. The insertion loss is at its lowest, approximately -6 dB at 10 GHz, and the isolation remains consistently below -10 dB across the specified frequency range.

articleTitle: Prototype of Automatic Control of Freight Elevator Models in a 3-Floor Building
publicationTitle: 2023 17th International Conference on Telecommunication Systems, Services, and Applications (TSSA)
abstract: Elevator is a means of transportation that is used as a means of vertical transportation in a high building, an elevator is used to transport people or goods. Freight elevators in modern times have automatic buttons, the problem that is common in simple freight elevators is that they are usually not regulated with complete automatic control buttons but are only determined by pressing the start and stop buttons which are operated manually so that they are not safe from a work safety standpoint. In an effort to minimize the risk of work accidents, in developing this prototype, designing an elevator model from manual buttons replaced with automatic buttons, efforts to control the process of working elevator models, namely a microcontroller are needed. The purpose of this study is to change the manual elevator control buttons to automatic elevator control buttons that are installed on each floor, by adding automatic door opening and closing and the process of going up and down the elevator cage automatically using rails equipped with timing belts and several electronic components. The stages in this research method are to design a prototype of the automatic arrangement of the freight elevator model in a three-floor building using the Arduino Mega 2560 based microcontroller method.
